title: Cobblemon Ascendant
description: The official pack for Cobblemon Ascendant: a Minecraft Pokemon MMO with a PokeRogue-style Depths mode, live hunts, eight gyms, ranked battles, and a player economy.
body:
# Cobblemon Ascendant

**Cobblemon Ascendant** is a Minecraft Pokemon MMO built around catching, battling, collecting, and long-term progression. This is the official client pack: install it, launch Minecraft, and the server is already waiting in your Multiplayer list.

**Minecraft Java 1.21.1 | Fabric | Cobblemon 1.7.3**

- **Server:** `play.cobblemonascendant.gg`
- **Discord:** https://discord.gg/uDtGV7pYaW
- **Website:** https://cobblemonascendant.gg

## Enter The Depths

The Depths is our PokeRogue-inspired solo roguelite. Choose a temporary starter, build a team from the Pokemon you catch during the run, choose routes and perks, defeat scaling bosses, and decide when to extract before a wipe costs what you are carrying.

Reach the required depth and you can keep one Pokemon from the run. Deep runs unlock additional rewards, including rare shiny extraction milestones.

## More Than Default Cobblemon

- **Eight Gyms, Elite Four, and Champion** - follow a guided quest path through curated teams and competitive battle AI.
- **GoCatch Scouts** - race to live shiny and legendary events, hold the contested zone, and earn the right to make the catch.
- **PvE Dungeons** - take on multi-battle gauntlets, manage healing between fights, defeat bosses, and forge exclusive utility gear.
- **Battle Tower and Ranked Battles** - test teams against scaling PvE floors or climb a seasonal player ladder.
- **Player Economy** - trade through the Auction House, build income with Pokemon Job Stations while you play, and spend through player and server shops.
- **Catch Combos** - chain catches for improving IV, shiny, spawn, and hidden-ability bonuses.
- **Clans and Challenges** - form a group, earn points through normal play, and compete in recurring clan challenges.
- **Training and Collection** - breeding, EV and IV tools, custom TMs and TRs, Pokédex rewards, Mega Evolution, cosmetics, plushies, and more.

The server is free to join and its full progression path is available without a purchase. Optional store ranks support the server and provide clearly listed convenience benefits and recurring kits.

## One Install, Ready to Play

The pack includes the required gameplay and client compatibility mods, plus a tuned performance and quality-of-life setup:

- Cobblemon and Mega Showdown, including the installed Z-A Mega content;
- Sodium, Lithium, Iris, and other performance improvements;
- Xaero's Minimap and World Map with Pokemon support;
- REI, Jade, inventory utilities, tooltips, and accessibility options;
- the official Ascendant client companion and preconfigured server entry.

## How to Join

1. Install **Cobblemon Ascendant** with the CurseForge App.
2. Allocate about **6 GB of memory** to Minecraft for the smoothest experience.
3. Press **Play**, open **Multiplayer**, and select **Cobblemon Ascendant**.
4. Accept the server resource pack, choose your starter, and follow the objective bar.

The server address is `play.cobblemonascendant.gg` if you ever need to add it manually.

## Need Help?

Join the Discord for support, update notes, events, trading, clans, and the live server-chat bridge:

https://discord.gg/uDtGV7pYaW
